name: ai.rubii/rubii-roleplay-mcp
title: Rubii Story Worldbuilder & Roleplay MCP
description: Interactive fiction worldbuilder, Character Card V2/V3 audit, 24K memory budget & Styles/Regex MCP.

tools.name: craft_story_world
tools.description: Generate a structured interactive fiction story world from a genre, atmosphere, and character dynamic—complete with world rules, character profile, a cinematic Scene One opening using {{user}}, three narrative branches, and a Character Card V2 draft ready to play on Rubii AI.

genre.description: Story genre or setting, e.g. "urban fantasy", "wuxia xianxia", "cyber noir", "mystery bookshop", or "historical intrigue".

atmosphere.description: Desired mood or sensory atmosphere, e.g. "rain-lit lantern alleys, slow-burn mystery".

relationshipDynamic.description: Core interpersonal tension with {{user}}, e.g. "guarded rivals forced into an alliance" or "old friends reuniting after five years".

protagonistHook.description: Optional shared secret, promise, or inciting object that anchors Scene One.

language.description: Preferred language for CTA notes and guidance (default: "en").

includeStatusBar.description: Whether to include an optional <status> scene-tracker instruction in the system prompt.

tools.name: build_status_bar_layout
tools.description: Generate a sandbox-safe static HTML + inline CSS layout (novel chapter header, RPG HUD, cyber telemetry, phone chat thread, or wax-sealed letter), a verified capture-group regex rule, and an LLM formatting instruction block compatible with Rubii AI Styles & Regex.

tagName.description: XML-style wrapper tag name (alphanumeric, hyphen, or underscore; default: "status").

title.description: Header label displayed at the top of the card.

accentColor.description: Optional 6-digit hex accent color such as "#7c9cff".

fields.description: Up to 8 custom key/label/exampleValue rows. Uses theme defaults when omitted.

key.description: Plain key emitted by the model, e.g. "Location".

label.description: Display label shown on the card.

exampleValue.description: Sample value for prompt instruction and preview.

display.description: Visual presentation for the field value.

tools.name: audit_character_card
tools.description: Validate Character Card V1, V2 (chara_card_v2), V3 (chara_card_v3), or exported character definitions (char_name / greeting / definition) for schema completeness, Lorebook integrity, regex syntax, {{char}}/{{user}} macro correctness, opening-scene pacing, and 8K/16K/24K/32K token fit.

card.description: Character Card JSON string or object (V1, V2, V3, or exported character definition).

strict.description: When true, treat warnings as validation failures (default: false).

tools.name: compare_story_memory_budget
tools.description: Estimate multi-turn interactive fiction context consumption across 8K, 16K, 24K, and 32K windows by breaking down permanent character sheets, constant/triggered Lorebook entries, editable Story Memo notes, and projected turn history.

memoText.description: Editable Story Memo / chapter summary text.

lorebookEntries.description: Lorebook / Worldbook entries with constant or triggered active state.

contextWindows.description: Target context window sizes in tokens (default: [8192, 16384, 24576, 32768]).

tools.name: explore_rubii_guides
tools.description: Return canonical Rubii AI documentation, localized interactive fiction guides, Styles & Regex tutorials, character card tools, and legal/support links aligned with https://rubii.ai/llms.txt.

language.description: Preferred user locale such as "en", "zh-hant", "zh", "ja", "th", "vi", "ko", "es", "pt", "ru", or "id".

intent.description: Specific guide category to filter by (default: "all").
